one_liner.title: One Liner (RHP)
one_liner.body: Pan-India provider of manpower services (manned security, IFM, sourcing/payroll), toll plaza management and skill development training, operating across 23 states and 5 union territories.

business_model.title: What they do
business_model.body: Innovision provides manpower services (manned private security, integrated facility management, and manpower sourcing/payroll), toll plaza user-fee collection management, and government-scheme skill development training. It began with manned private security in 2007, added skill development in Fiscal 2014 and toll plaza management in Fiscal 2019. Through subsidiaries it also offers recruitment/visa facilitation (Innovision International) and remote-pilot drone training (Aerodrone Robotics).

group_structure.title: Group structure (subsidiaries / JV / related parties)
group_structure.body:
- Innovision International Private Limited — Wholly-owned subsidiary: Recruitment, placement consultancy and visa facilitation; RCIC certified
- Aerodrone Robotics Private Limited — Subsidiary: Remote pilot / drone-operations training
- Innovision HR Consultancy LLC - Dubai — Foreign group entity: Directorship held by promoter

products.title: Products & brands
products.body:
- **Manpower Services:** Manned Private Security Services, Integrated Facility Management (Hard FM / Soft FM), Manpower Sourcing and Payroll
- **Toll Plaza Management:** User-fee collection and related services on national-highway toll plazas (NHAI empanelled)
- **Skill Development Training:** Government-scheme vocational training across sectors (healthcare, BFSI, retail, logistics, etc.)
- **Subsidiary services:** Recruitment, placement consultancy and visa facilitation (Innovision International), Remote pilot / drone-operations training (Aerodrone Robotics)

end_markets.title: End Markets (RHP)
end_markets.body:
- Toll Plaza Management (56.14% of FY25 revenue)
- Manpower Services (41.38% of FY25 revenue)
- Skill Development Training (2.46% of FY25 revenue)
- Government and PSU clients
- Private clients across healthcare, retail, warehousing, logistics, BFSI

certifications.title: Certs (RHP)
certifications.body:
- PSARA (Private Security Agencies Regulation Act) licences
- Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC) certification

cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: Service business - no manufacturing supply chain. Labour-intensive; deploys own and empanelled/contract personnel across client premises. Note: customer-concentration percentages above are of the Manpower Services segment only (the DRHP does not provide a group-wide top-customer table); toll revenue is authority/NHAI-contract driven.

customers.title: Oem (RHP)
customers.body:
- NHAI (toll collection empanelment)
- Sector skill councils and state skill missions (skill development)
- Canadian agency (RCIC certification via Innovision International)

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- Toll plaza management scaled sharply (₹333.33 mn FY23 to ₹5,014.33 mn FY25) to become the largest segment
- Government vs private client mix in manpower services
- Contract/tender win-rate and performance-guarantee obligations
- Working-capital cycle from receivables on government contracts

capital_allocation.title: Strategy & capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- Deepen relationships with existing clients to capture greater share of their manpower requirements
- Expand toll plaza management footprint via NHAI/authority tenders
- Grow skill development as training partner for central/state government schemes
- Develop drone-operations training through Aerodrone Robotics subsidiary

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: Growth is service/contract-led rather than plant-led: expansion of manpower client base (180+ clients, 1,000+ premises), additional toll plaza tenders with NHAI/authorities, and new verticals in drone training and international recruitment/visa services.

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- Wide geographical reach across 23 states and 5 union territories
- Diverse portfolio of manpower services enabling cross-sell and recurring business
- Established systems and processes supporting a scalable business model
- Experienced management and operational team
- Recruitment capability, domain knowledge and knowledge of labour regulations

risks.title: Bear — key risks
risks.body:
- Debarment / blacklisting by clients — Gujarat Gas debarment (revoked on ₹2.07 mn payment) and NHAI contract termination + one-year debarment (challenged in Punjab & Haryana High Court) can bar participation in future tenders
- Customer / segment concentration — Top 10 manpower clients ~57% of segment revenue; toll plaza segment 56% of total revenue dependent on tender renewals
- Dependence on government contracts and tender-based bidding — Revenue tied to competitive tenders, earnest-money deposits and performance guarantees
- Working-capital intensity — Labour-intensive service model with receivables from government/PSU clients
- Regulatory compliance (PSARA, labour laws) — Licensing and statutory labour compliance across many states

commitments.title: Promises (RHP)
commitments.body:
- **Repay/prepay borrowings from net proceeds**
- **Fund incremental working capital requirements from net proceeds**
- **Expand pan-India operations across states/UTs and client premises**
- **Build drone-operations / remote-pilot training through Aerodrone Robotics**

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Deepen relationships with existing clients to capture greater share of their manpower requirements
- Expand toll plaza management footprint via NHAI/authority tenders
- Grow skill development as training partner for central/state government schemes
- Develop drone-operations training through Aerodrone Robotics subsidiary
